title: My Daughter-In-Law Forged A Dissolution And Stole $520K, Then Sent Me A $2,800 Candle. So I Voided The Sale
description: After I used my late husband’s $85,000 life insurance to launch a candle company with my daughter‑in‑law, she forged a dissolution, sold our brand for $520,000, and mailed me a $2,800 “thank‑you” candle. I discovered the original fifty‑fifty agreement wax‑sealed inside a mold, voided the sale, and now she wicks jars under the brand “Wick of Deceit Candles” while every candle bottom prints her perjury docket. #Betrayal #Revenge #TrueStory
thumb_text: HER PERJURY IS ON EVERY CANDLE
pinned_comment: If my daughter-in-law forged a dissolution, stole $520,000, and sent me a $2,800 candle, I'd void the sale too. What would you have done? Share your story in the comments.
